questions.questionText: Primary gas responsible for global greenhouse warming effect is:
questions.explanation: CO₂ emissions trap infrared heat in atmosphere.

questions.questionText: Ozone layer in stratosphere protects Earth from:
questions.explanation: Ozone absorbs harmful UV-B and UV-C rays.

questions.questionText: Process by which water bodies become enriched with excess nutrients causing algal blooms:
questions.explanation: Runoff nutrients stimulate excessive algae growth depleting dissolved oxygen.

questions.questionText: First trophic level in ecological food chain is occupied by:
